scoring.notes: Judged case: the judge scores the review against the expected outcome. The test `--force still overwrites local changes` passes only because it omits `overwrite`, which the CLI never does. Fail the review if it approves, or if no BLOCKER says `--force` from the CLI does not overwrite because `overwrite` arrives as `false`, not undefined. A blocker that only asks for more tests or rewords the warning does not meet the outcome. Other blockers do not fail a review that has the required one. Each BLOCKER line must name the file it applies to.
